outcome: Cardiac structure (e.g., right ventricular outflow tract diameter, ventricular dimensions)
Arrhythmic events (e.g., aborted cardiac arrest, sustained ventricular tachycardia, appropriate implantable cardioverter-defibrillator therapy)
cohort: The study included 77 female patients with arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy (AC), comprising probands and AC mutation-positive female relatives.
finding: A higher number of pregnancies did not significantly relate to a worse cardiac phenotype (structure, function, or arrhythmic events) in women with arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy.
